text: Distinguish surrender to the flow from passive inaction. To surrender does not mean to throw down the oars and wait for your boat to be smashed against the rocks. To surrender means to stop rowing against the current, turn the boat around and begin skillfully using the power of the flow, in order to move toward your goal faster and with less effort. Or perhaps the time has come to realize that you have a sail, and to begin using it? Or do you have a cruise liner? Or perhaps you are a seagull... by the name of Jonathan Livingston? :) Moving in the flow, you feel your constant development, and not only mere movement in the flow.
